more_info.uses: EU permissions include fine bakery wares. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no concern for the assessed limited food uses.
Higher-dose animal studies identified nervous-system effects of aluminium.
more_info.overview: Sodium aluminium phosphate is classified in food technology as an emulsifier. Its technological role is to help oil and water stay mixed.
